history.p: Gade apparently began working on his quintet on his way back to Denmark in the summer of 1844, but cancelled the sketch and did not take it up again until September 1845. Shortly after it had been finished, it was performed at a soirée in Gewandhaus in Leipzig by members of Gewandhausorchester and Gade himself.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper. 10 staves. Notated on two staves. With sporadic indications of instrumentation.

2 bifolios. Written in ink. Paper: 12 staves. Heading on fol.1r: "Quintet"; dated "Basel 27 Juli 44." In upper right-hand corner. On the first bifolio a sketch in E minor, tempo indication Andante, 6/8 notated on two staves end-dated "Basel. 27 Juli 1844." All four pages have been cancelled. On the second bifolio fol.1r/v and fol.2r a sketch in F major with the tempo indication Agitato, 3/4 also notated on two staves.These pages have also been cancelled. On fol.2v a sketch dated "Hamburg 6. Aug" with the tempo indication "langsam". In upper left-hand corner: "Quintet.".

physDesc.physMedium: 10 bifolios and 1 single folio. Paper: 16 staves (first movement, pp. 1-12) and 20 staves (pp. 13-46). Written in ink. With major and minor corrections. First movement end-dated "3 Martz / 45." on p. 12; second movement end-dated "30 Sept /1845." On p. 21; third movement end-dated "6 Oct: /45"; after the final double bar-line on p. 46 Gade has written: "Fine / Leipzig / 1- November / 1845. / [Gade's musical signature]" and in the right-hand margin: "Königstr. 16."
